title: qPCR Assay for Detecting Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis
author: Omneya Osman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baiticen
materials: Qiagen DNeasy Power Water Sterivex Kit

DNA extraction was performed using Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex kit. The quality of the extracted DNA was estimated using Nanodrop. Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex kit: https://www.qiagen.com/se/resources/resourcedetail?id=c5fe7d5f-070a-4ebe-ac04-4bbf05a13e91&lang=en

QPCR was performed in BioRad qPCR machine CFX96. Analysis of the results was done by CFX maestro software https://www.bio-rad.com/en-se/product/cfx-maestro-software-for-cfx-real-time-pcr-instruments?ID=OKZP7E15 02:30:00

steps.title: Prepare Control Templates
steps.instruction: Resuspend the internal control template and positive control template in the supplied template preparation buffer in a separate laboratory environment to avoid contamination.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 90 μl of template preparation buffer into 8 labeled tubes.
Pipette 10 μl of Positive Control Template (RED) into tube 2.
Change pipette tip and pipette 10 μl from tube 2 into tube 3.
Repeat the transfer and vortexing steps to complete the dilution series.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR mixture using SsoAdvanced Universal Probes Supermix, B.dendrobatidis primer/probe mix (BROWN), and RNase/DNase free water (WHITE) according to the required volume.

substeps.instruction: For a 15 μl mix: 10 μl Supermix, 1 μl primer/probe mix, 4 μl water.
For a 150 μl mix: 100 μl Supermix, 10 μl primer/probe mix, 40 μl water.
For a 225 μl mix: 150 μl Supermix, 15 μl primer/probe mix, 60 μl water.
For a 375 μl mix: 250 μl Supermix, 25 μl primer/probe mix, 100 μl water.
For a 7 μl mix: 5 μl Supermix, 0.5 μl primer/probe mix, 1.5 μl water.

steps.title: Add DNA Template
steps.instruction: Add the DNA template or water to the reaction mixture to reach the final volume.

substeps.instruction: For a 20 μl total PCR mixture: Pipette 5 μl of DNA template (or 5 μl RNase/DNase free water for negative controls).
For a 10 μl total PCR mixture: Pipette 3 μl of DNA template (or 3 μl RNase/DNase free water for negative controls).

steps.title: Run qPCR Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the qPCR program using the following thermal cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: Cycling (x50): Denaturation at 95 °C for 10 s, followed by data collection at 60 °C for 1 min.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the Quantitation cycle (Cq) values to determine the result and quality control.

substeps.instruction: Verify Positive Control: Template (1e6 per 5 μl) should amplify between Cq 16 and 23.
Verify Internal Control: Normal range is Cq 28 ± 3 (note: may not amplify if B. dendrobatidis copy number is very high).
Interpret Negative Control: If negative control is positive with Cq > 35, reinterpret the sample based on relative signal strength.
